meta.quiz_name: ICAO-第八章 其他情况通话术语

questions.content: We have three serious and five minor injuries on board. Request ambulances on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们机上有三人重伤，五人轻伤。请求救护车到场。

questions.content: One passenger is having difficulty breathing. Request descent to a lower level to reduce cabin altitude.
questions.trans: 一名旅客呼吸困难。请求立即下降到较低高度以减小客舱高度。

questions.content: A passenger activated the overhead emergency oxygen generator. Request airport security on arrival to detain this individual.
questions.trans: 一名旅客触发了顶部紧急氧气发生器。请求机场保安到场拘留他。

questions.content: A stressed passenger attempted to open an emergency exit. Request airport security on arrival.
questions.trans: 一名闹情绪的旅客试图打开应急出口。申请机场保安到场。

questions.content: We have a hostage situation. Request stair vehicles on standby to disembark the passengers.
questions.trans: 我们有一名人质。申请客梯车待命以便让旅客们下飞机。

questions.content: We have a passenger with severe hyperventilation. He has received first aid but his condition is not improving. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们有一名旅客有严重的过度换气症。他得到了急救但情况没有好转。申请救护车到场。

questions.content: We have a passenger with a suspected heart attack. Request diversion to a suitable airport.
questions.trans: 我们有名乘客疑似有心脏病。申请备降到合适机场。

questions.content: A pregnant passenger is in severe pain. Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 一名孕妇承受剧痛。申请优先着陆和救护车到场。

questions.content: There was a fight onboard among a few passengers. One of them is now bleeding seriously. Request police and ambulances on arrival.
questions.trans: 几名旅客在机上打斗。其中一人现在流血严重。请求警察和救护车到场。

questions.content: The purser told me the injured passenger has blood type O. Maybe this information is useful to the paramedics.
questions.trans: 乘务长告知我受伤旅客血型是O型血。或许该信息对急救医务人员有用。

questions.content: We have an 8-month old infant with head injuries. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们有个8个月大的婴儿头部受伤。申请救护车到场。

questions.content: A passenger is unconscious after suffering from seizure. The cabin crew is giving her first aid. We will advise if we require a diversion.
questions.trans: 一名旅客癫痫发作后失去知觉。客舱机组提供急救。如需备降我们将告知你们。

questions.content: Many passengers and crew were injured due severe turbulence. We will advise the number and severity of injuries when able.
questions.trans: 由于严重颠簸，多名旅客和机组都受伤了。如能够，我们将告知受伤人数和严重性。

questions.content: An elderly passenger has passed away. We will continue to our destination. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 一位年长的旅客去世了。我们将继续到目的地。请求救护车到场。

questions.content: We found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory. Request police and ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们发现一名旅客在洗手间服药（或毒品）过量失去意识了。请求警察和救护车到场。

questions.content: The sick passenger’s condition has improved. We no longer require the diversion. Request to continue to our destination.
questions.trans: 生病旅客的情况已经好转了。我们不再要求备降，请求继续飞往我们的目的地。

questions.content: We received an emergency call from the cabin, but now nobody is responding. We can hear shouting and disturbance. Our cabin crew might be under duress.
questions.trans: 我们收到客舱的急救呼叫，但现在没人回应。我们能听见喊叫声和斗殴声。我们的客舱机组可能受到了胁迫。

questions.content: We have a hijack situation on board. Can our destination airport provide armed intervention?
questions.trans: 我们被劫机了。我们的目的地机场能提供武装干涉吗？

questions.content: We can see two masked men with sharp weapons on our cockpit door surveillance camera. They are kicking the cockpit door.
questions.trans: 我们通过驾驶舱监控摄像机看见两个头戴面具手拿利器的人。他们正在踢驾驶舱门。

questions.content: I can see the area outside of the cockpit. There are two hijack suspects standing in the aisle.
questions.trans: 我能看见驾驶舱外面区域。有两名劫机者正站在过道。

questions.content: One of the terrorists is about forty years old. He is about 180 cm tall, wearing a brown shirt and dark pants.
questions.trans: 一名恐怖分子大约40岁。他有180厘米高，穿着棕色衬衫和深色裤子。

questions.content: A terrorist is trying to access the cockpit. He is about 30 years old. He is wearing a hat and backpack.
questions.trans: 一名恐怖分子正试图接近驾驶舱。他约30岁。戴一顶帽子并双肩背包。

questions.content: The purser reports there are over ten hijackers onboard. They are threatening to kill passengers if we don’t fly to another destination.
questions.trans: 乘务长报告机上有超过10名劫机犯。正威胁我们如果不飞往另一个目的地，他们要杀死旅客。

questions.content: Some of the hijackers are carrying sharp protruding weapons.
questions.trans: 一些劫机犯拿着锋利的、尖锐的武器。

questions.content: There is a stand-off in the cabin. Some of the hijackers are carrying blades.
questions.trans: 客舱已陷于僵持状态。一些劫机犯拿着刀片。

questions.content: Terrorists started to injure passengers.
questions.trans: 恐怖分子开始伤害旅客了。

questions.content: We will remain on the runway. The hijackers have taken four hostages to the rear of the cabin.
questions.trans: 我们将停留在跑道上。劫机犯已把四名人质带到了客舱后部。

questions.content: Terrorists are threatening to start killing passengers and the crew.
questions.trans: 恐怖分子们威胁他们将要杀死旅客和机组了。

questions.content: The air marshal and passengers have restrained five suspects. The situation is now under control.
questions.trans: 安全保安和旅客们已经制服了五名疑犯。局面得到了控制。

questions.content: A suspicious suitcase was found during the cabin inspection.
questions.trans: 客舱检查中发现了可疑手提箱。

questions.content: The air marshal is searching the aircraft interior for any suspicious articles.
questions.trans: 空中保安正在搜查飞机里面的任何可疑物品。

questions.content: Some explosives were discovered behind a panel near the back of the cabin.
questions.trans: 客舱后部的一块面板后面发现一些爆炸物。

questions.content: What do the bomb-disposal experts suggest we do?
questions.trans: 拆弹专家们建议我们做什么？

questions.content: The cabin crew reports a passenger is behaving strangely.
questions.trans: 客舱机组报告一名旅客行为怪异。

questions.content: A bomb has exploded and the cabin is full of smoke. Request emergency descent.
questions.trans: 炸弹已爆炸，客舱到处是烟雾。申请紧急下降。

questions.content: We are evacuating on the runway. Be advised the bomb is still on board.
questions.trans: 我们正在跑道上紧急撤离。请你告知相关人员炸弹还在飞机上。

questions.content: We are unsure of our position due to navigation failure. If any station can hear me, please respond.
questions.trans: 由于导航失效，我们不确定位置。如有任何电台能听到我们，请回话。

questions.content: We only have standby magnetic compass due instrument failure. Now heading 245. Request navigation assistance.
questions.trans: 我们因仪表失效只有备用磁罗盘。现在航向245。请求导航援助。

questions.content: We are unsure of our position due FMS failure. Last known position five miles north of FUPAD, now heading 165 for weather avoidance.
questions.trans: 我们由于飞行管理计算机失效不能确定位置。最后已知位置FUPAD以北5海里，现在航向165以避开天气。

questions.content: We have navigation map drift. Request climb to MEA.
questions.trans: 我们有导航地图漂移。申请上升到最低航路高度。

questions.content: Our cargo manifest shows that there are 80 kilograms of lithium batteries on board.
questions.trans: 我们货物舱单表明机上有80千克的锂电池。

questions.content: A ramp inspection discovered crates of lithium batteries in the cargo hold. We are verifying. Request delay pushback.
questions.trans: 机坪检查发现货舱有数箱锂电池。我们正在核实。请求延迟推出。

questions.content: We had a smoke warning in the cargo hold. We have discharged the fire extinguisher. We are concerned about lithium batteries in that compartment.
questions.trans: 我们的货舱有烟雾警告。我们已释放灭火瓶。我们担心货舱的锂电池。

questions.content: The cabin crew have used up all the portable extinguishers. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 客舱机组已用完了手提式灭火器，申请备降。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: Request passenger stairs connect immediately after we stop on the runway. We want to disembark passengers as quickly as possible.
questions.trans: 我们停在跑道上后请求立即连接客梯车。我们想尽快让旅客离机。

questions.content: We almost had a mid-air collision with another aircraft.
questions.trans: 我们差点与另一架飞机空中相撞。

questions.content: The conflicting traffic is military. Request avoiding action.
questions.trans: 冲突飞机是军用机。申请避让措施。

questions.content: Does the flight path of the unknown aircraft converge with ours?
questions.trans: 不明飞机的飞行路线和我们会聚吗？

questions.content: The conflicting traffic is gray, possibly a military aircraft.
questions.trans: 冲突飞机是灰色的，可能是军用机。

questions.content: We have traffic indication at 2 o’clock, 300 feet above our level.
questions.trans: 冲突飞机显示在2点钟方位，高于我们300英尺。

questions.content: We have a possible traffic conflict at 10 o’clock, converging with our flight path.
questions.trans: 我们可能在10点钟方位有冲突飞机，与我们的飞行线路会聚。

questions.content: We have a possible traffic conflict ahead. Request radar vectors for avoidance.
questions.trans: 我们前方可能有冲突飞机，请求雷达引导避让。

questions.content: Request right turn for traffic avoidance.
questions.trans: 请求右转避让冲突飞机。

questions.content: Unable to comply, TCAS RA.
questions.trans: 不能照办，遵守TCASRA指令。

questions.content: We nearly collided with that aircraft. We had very little vertical separation. Do you know the flight number of that aircraft?
questions.trans: 我们几乎与那架飞机相撞了。我们几乎没有垂直间隔了。你们知道那架飞机的航班号吗？

questions.content: Clear of conflict, request further instructions.
questions.trans: 远离冲突，申请进一步指令。

questions.content: We have injuries resulting from our TCAS maneuver. Request ambulance on arrival.
questions.trans: TCAS机动导致部分旅客受伤。请求救护车到场。

questions.content: Some of the cabin crew are injured. They were serving meals during the TCAS maneuver.
questions.trans: 部分客舱机组受伤了。TCAS机动时他们正在供餐。

questions.content: Some passengers were injured because their seatbelts weren’t fastened.
questions.trans: 一些旅客受伤是因为他们没有系安全带。

questions.content: Some passengers have been scalded by hot drinks.
questions.trans: 一些旅客被热饮料烫伤了。

questions.content: We have about thirty injured persons on board, four are very serious. Can you deliver this message to the medical staff that are standing by?
questions.trans: 我们机上有三十人受伤。其中四人受伤严重。你能把此信息告知待命的医疗人员吗？

questions.content: We overran the runway end. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: 我们冲出了跑道头。我们正在撤离。请求紧急服务。

questions.content: We veered off the runway. We are evacuating near the runway and rapid exit J5.
questions.trans: 我们偏出了跑道，正在撤离。我们的位置在跑道和快速脱离道口J5附近。

questions.content: We will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
questions.trans: 如果我们进一步延误，我们将达到最低燃油量。

questions.content: We are declaring minimum fuel. We will have less than 30 minutes endurance by the time we get to our destination.
questions.trans: 我们宣布最低燃油量。我们到达目的地之后会有少于30分钟续航时间。

questions.content: We are declaring fuel emergency. Our endurance is 1 hour 58 minutes. We are 1 hour 30 minutes from the closest alternate airport.
questions.trans: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。我们的续航时间1小时58分钟。我们离最近备降场时间是1小时30分钟。

questions.content: We are declaring fuel emergency. Request priority landing Runway 03R.
questions.trans: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。申请优先着陆，跑道03右。

questions.content: We have been intercepted by a military aircraft. It is rocking its wings to indicate we should follow.
questions.trans: 我们被一架军用飞机拦截了。它摇动机翼让我们跟着它。

questions.content: I’m trying to identify the type and nationality of the military aircraft. So far, no response on 121.5.
questions.trans: 我们正试着识别军用飞机的机型和国籍。到目前为止，121.5频率没有回应。

questions.content: The military aircraft is commanding us to land at the airfield below.
questions.trans: 军用飞机正在指示我们在下面的机场着陆。

questions.content: The military aircraft has made an abrupt maneuver indicating we may continue on this heading.
questions.trans: 军用飞机已突然机动，表明我们可以继续保持此航向。

questions.content: We are being escorted towards the national boundary by two military aircraft.
questions.trans: 我们正在被两架军用机押送到国境线。

questions.content: We are heading 085. This heading allows us to quickly exit the prohibited airspace.
questions.trans: 我们现在航向085。该航向我们可以快速离开禁飞空域。

questions.content: If we continue to make orbits we will exceed our duty time limit by the time we land.
questions.trans: 如我们继续转圈，我们将在落地时超出值勤期限制。

questions.content: A crew member is incapacitated. Request diversion and medical assistance.
questions.trans: 一名机组成员失能。请求备降和医疗救助。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: They have revived the unconscious passenger by CPR procedure. It looks like he’ll be fine. Request to cancel the diversion.
questions.trans: 他们通过心肺复苏程序使失去知觉的旅客恢复了意识。似乎情况不错。申请取消备降。

questions.content: Confirm we are being vectored to fly overhead the airport for right downwind.
questions.trans: 证实你会引导我们飞越机场上空然后做右三边。

questions.content: Confirm we have enough separation from preceding aircraft.
questions.trans: 证实我们与前机有足够间隔。

questions.content: Unable to expedite climb due performance.
questions.trans: 由于性能，不能加速爬升。

questions.content: Negative contact due visibility.
questions.trans: 由于能见度，不能看见（那一架飞机）。

questions.content: Unable, we are in IMC.
questions.trans: 不能，我们在仪表天气条件。

questions.content: Unable, we are only authorized during daytime VMC.
questions.trans: 不能，我们只有白天目视气象条件的资格。

questions.content: Unable noise abatement due company policy.
questions.trans: 由于公司政策，不能执行降噪音程序。

questions.content: Did the previous controller tell you about our problem during radar handoff?
questions.trans: 雷达移交时前面的管制员告诉你我们的问题了吗？

questions.content: Is there a frequency change at this compulsory reporting point?
questions.trans: 在此强制性报告点需要换频率吗？

questions.content: Unable speed 180 knots. We need to maintain a good speed in clean configuration due icing.
questions.trans: 不能保持速度180节。由于积冰，我们需要保持光洁形态和适当的速度。

questions.content: Unable to reduce speed below mach decimal 74. You can vector us if you’d like.
questions.trans: 速度不能调至低于马赫数点74。你可以引导让我们飞航向。

questions.content: Request runway change for departure due high crosswind.
questions.trans: 由于较大侧风，请求换起飞跑道。

questions.content: Request delay the approach due tail wind beyond limits.
questions.trans: 由于顺风超限，请求延迟进近。

questions.content: Request holding instructions due weather near the runway threshold.
questions.trans: 由于跑道入口处附近的天气，请求等待指令。

questions.content: Unable, an immediate right turn might not give us enough terrain clearance. Our turn radius is 4 miles at this speed.
questions.trans: 不能，立即右转的话我们越过地形的裕度可能不够。当前速度的转弯半径是4海里。

questions.content: Sorry, there was a problem with my audio equipment. How do you read me now?
questions.trans: 抱歉，因为我们的音频设备有问题。现在你听我几个？

questions.content: We had to overshoot because of wake turbulence.
questions.trans: 我们不得不复飞的原因是尾流。

questions.content: Not ready for immediate takeoff due possible wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft.
questions.trans: 没有准备好立即起飞，刚起飞的重型机可能有尾流。

questions.content: Unable CAT II approach due crew qualification.
questions.trans: 不能Ⅱ类进近的原因是机组资质。 Note: CAT读为Catgory。

questions.content: Transmission blocked, say again.
questions.trans: 被干扰了，再说一遍。

questions.content: Standby, high pilot workload.
questions.trans: 稍等，飞行员工作负荷较大。

questions.content: Are you banning us from entry because of our airline or our aircraft type?
questions.trans: 你禁止我们飞入是因为我们公司或我们的机型吗？

questions.content: Our aircraft has the required certification and is approved by your Civil Aviation Authority for scheduled flight.
questions.trans: 我们飞机有相应的资质，你们民航当局也批准我们可以执行定期航班。

questions.content: We had to go around due to unstable approach.
questions.trans: 我们必须复飞是因为进近不稳定。
